title: 计算复杂性应用
text: 随着信息技术的飞速发展，计算复杂性理论已成为评估算法效率的核心基准。该领域主要探讨解决特定问题所需的时间与空间资源。其核心在于区分多项式时间可解问题与非确定性多项式时间问题。这种理论框架为密码学提供了坚实的数学支撑。现代加密协议依赖于某些计算任务在实际操作中难以在有限时间内完成。例如，大整数分解的困难性确保了公钥加密系统的安全性。若能证明P等于NP，现有的数字签名机制将面临崩溃。除了安全领域，该理论在物流优化中同样至关重要。旅行商问题揭示了组合优化在规模扩大时的指数级增长特性。研究人员通过近似算法在精度与速度之间寻求平衡。在生物信息学领域，蛋白质折叠预测涉及海量状态空间的搜索。利用复杂性分析，科学家能够剔除无效路径以提高计算效能。金融量化交易亦采用了类似的逻辑来优化投资组合。通过降低计算复杂度，交易系统得以在毫秒级时间内做出决策。人工智能的训练过程本质上是对高维函数空间的搜索。深度学习的收敛速度直接关联到计算资源的消耗量。编译器优化则旨在将高级语言转换为执行效率最高的机器指令。这种转化过程需要对指令集复杂度有深刻理解。在网络路由协议中，最短路径算法的复杂度决定了数据传输的延迟。分布式系统通过权衡一致性与可用性来应对规模化挑战。这种权衡在理论上被定义为CAP定理。量子计算的兴起可能重新定义现有的复杂度等级。量子比特的叠加特性有望在极短时间内破解传统难题。这促使研究者开发抗量子加密算法以应对潜在威胁。总之，复杂性理论不仅是纯粹的数学推演，更是驱动工业进步的底层逻辑。它为人类处理海量数据的能力设定了理论上限。

questions.prompt: According to the text, what would happen to existing digital signature mechanisms if P were proven to equal NP?
options: They would collapse
They would become permanently unbreakable
They would require no changes at all
They would only affect logistics, not cryptography

questions.prompt: What does the traveling salesman problem illustrate, according to the text?
options: The exponential growth of combinatorial-optimization difficulty as problem scale increases
That all optimization problems can be solved instantly regardless of size
That logistics problems have no relation to computational complexity
That salesmen always choose the shortest possible route in practice

questions.prompt: What is the CAP theorem, as described in the text, related to?
options: The tradeoff distributed systems make between consistency and availability
The relationship between price and computing power
The three laws of robotics
The comparison between analog and digital computing

questions.prompt: What might the rise of quantum computing do to existing hard problems, according to the text?
options: Potentially break them in an extremely short time, due to qubit superposition
Make them permanently unsolvable by any method
Have no impact on cryptography or complexity theory
Only apply to problems in bioinformatics

questions.prompt: According to the text's conclusion, what is complexity theory beyond pure mathematical deduction?
options: The underlying logic driving industrial progress
A purely theoretical field with no practical applications
A branch of biology rather than mathematics
A field made obsolete by the advent of quantum computing

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.
